tester_rules.mapping: Verify every material, event, character and authority reference against the concrete AS and reject lost conditions, semantic substitution, unknown references or expanded authority.
tester_rules.no_automatic_pass: Presence of mapping fields or matching hashes does not prove semantic equivalence.
tester_rules.professional_consistency: Evaluate the adapted projection together with the concrete AS; source-only names and objects are closed provenance and are not required literally in the adapted situation.
tester_rules.semantic_equivalence: For every adapted target verify that author meaning, observability conditions, constraints and invariants remain testable in the concrete AS.
tester_rules.source_preservation: Compare author.targets with the frozen author source byte-for-meaning and checksum.
